sloka: सीतया प्युपवस्तव्या रजनीयं मया सह ।एवमृत्विगुपाध्यायैस्सह मामुक्तवान् पिता ॥२-४-३६॥
transliteration: sītayā pyupavastavyā rajanīyaṁ mayā saha ।evamṛtvigupādhyāyaissaha māmuktavān pitā ॥2-4-36॥

translations.english: Hearing this, which she had longed for through so long a time, Kausalya, choked with tears of joy, spoke these words to Rama.
translations.hindi: अतएव ( इस पारितोषिक के अतिरिक्त ) और जो कुछ तू माँगे सो कह, अभी . तुमे में देती हुँ
